feed.title: NPR Topics: Business
feed.subtitle: Find the latest business news with reports on Wall Street, interest rates, banking, companies, and U.S. and world financial markets. Subscribe to the Business Story of the Day podcast.

entry.title: Trump issues new executive orders on beef sales to pacify American cattle ranchers
entry.summary: President Trump's latest executive orders allows ranchers to sell meat directly to consumers. Ranchers have been upset over Trump's plan to boost beef imports in a bid to lower prices.

entry.title: Former State Department energy envoy on how the war in Iran is impacting gas prices
entry.summary: NPR's Ayesha Rascoe talks to former State Department energy envoy David Goldwyn about how the war in Iran continues to affect gas and diesel prices.

entry.title: 4 things investigators learned about the dysfunction at Trump's Labor Department
entry.summary: A report from Labor Department investigators found former Labor Secretary Lori Chavez-DeRemer violated her own department's policy prohibiting harassment. She resigned in April.

entry.title: Pulling the SNAP lever + Why Gen Zers bet (invest?) differently
entry.summary: Changing SNAP eligibility actually can change consumption habits.

entry.title: 'How do you know if it's real?' Luxury reseller faces Chanel lawsuit
entry.summary: How do you know if a secondhand luxury good bought online is real? That's at the heart of a lawsuit filed by Chanel against the luxury reseller, The RealReal.

entry.title: The price of diesel hits a record high
entry.summary: The price of diesel has reached an all-time high, a result of the war in Iran and Ukraine's attacks on Russian refineries. That will matter across the supply chain.

entry.title: Fox News abruptly parts ways with scandal-tarred star Maria Bartiromo
entry.summary: Fox News abruptly announced it had cut ties with anchor Maria Bartiromo after more than a dozen years.

entry.title: The IRS slashed its staff. One result? More taxes going uncollected
entry.summary: The IRS slashed its auditing staff last year — but the move may have backfired as tax collections from enforcement efforts plummeted, an Inspector General report shows.

entry.title: Chevron to expand in Venezuela, days after the U.S. and Venezuela strike oil deal
entry.summary: Chevron is the largest foreign oil operator in Venezuela. The deal will expand its footprint at a time of political and economic uncertainty for Venezuela.

entry.title: New lawsuits claim OpenAI execs put image ahead of safety in Canadian mass shooting
entry.summary: The suits say that recommendations to alert police about the alleged shooter were nixed by OpenAI's global affairs team, led by veteran political strategist Chris Lehane. OpenAI denies the claims.
